problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 7 delivery trucks to complete 7 different multi-stage routes.  

Each route consists of a sequence of checkpoint stops represented as pairs (Checkpoint, Service time), where each pair specifies the checkpoint where the truck must stop and the amount of time required for service. The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the stops must be visited.

Route details:  
* R1 follows the sequence: (C6, 7) → (C1, 1) → (C7, 10) → (C4, 1) → (C2, 7) → (C3, 2) → (C5, 5)  
* R2 follows the sequence: (C2, 1) → (C6, 4) → (C3, 1) → (C7, 1) → (C1, 7) → (C5, 9) → (C4, 1)  
* R3 follows the sequence: (C2, 1) → (C1, 9) → (C5, 10) → (C7, 7) → (C6, 2) → (C4, 9) → (C3, 3)  
* R4 follows the sequence: (C2, 4) → (C7, 7) → (C4, 1) → (C5, 10) → (C6, 5) → (C1, 1) → (C3, 10)  
* R5 follows the sequence: (C3, 10) → (C6, 9) → (C7, 2) → (C5, 5) → (C4, 2) → (C2, 2) → (C1, 5)  
* R6 follows the sequence: (C1, 4) → (C6, 7) → (C2, 9) → (C5, 9) → (C4, 2) → (C7, 9) → (C3, 2)  
* R7 follows the sequence: (C6, 9) → (C4, 6) → (C1, 3) → (C7, 7) → (C2, 5) → (C5, 7) → (C3, 2)  

Each stop must be serviced continuously once it begins, and each checkpoint can only accommodate one truck at a time.  
The objective is to determine the service schedule of all stops at the checkpoints so that the total completion time for all routes is minimized.
